ruleToc.chapterList: <js>var s=siteOf(baseUrl);var out=[];if(!s)out;else if(s.kind==='api'){var L=JSON.parse(String(result)).list[0];var uf=String(L.vod_play_from||'').split('$$$');var uu=String(L.vod_play_url||'').split('$$$');for(var f=0;f<uu.length;f++){var seg=uu[f].split('#');for(var i=0;i<seg.length;i++){var p=seg[i].split('$');if(p.length<2||!p[1])continue;out.push({t:(uf[f]||'线路')+' '+p[0],h:p[1]})}}}else{java.setContent(String(result),strip(baseUrl));var rl=s.t.chapterList;var els=java.getElements(ruleOf(rl));for(var j=0;j<els.size();j++){var el=els.get(j);var u=abs(s.base,pickUrl(java,s.t.chapterUrl,el));if(u)out.push({t:pick(java,s.t.chapterName,el),h:u})}if(reversed(rl))out.reverse()}out</js>
